document.abstract: One of the major inherent characteristics of scientists, engineers, and technically trained personnel, either as individuals or as groups of individuals, is a general tendency to be overmodest about their accomplishments. The membership comprising the Society of Motion Picture Engineers is no exception to this characteristic, but it does seem justifiable to review the technical accomplishments of our Society on the basis of the record.
